zh.title: 西南航空第二座位退款與航班載客率掛鉤
zh.summary: 西南航空第二座位退款取決於載客率，旅客成本仍不確定
body: Simple Flying報導，西南航空新的 Customer of Size 座位政策中，第二個座位的退款取決於航班載客率。報導摘要指出，這使較大體型旅客面臨不確定的費用；標題則稱，相關航班通常載客率約為八成。
報導將退款與航班載客狀況連結，並把旅客可能面臨的費用不確定性列為此安排的影響。標題以「賭注」形容這項退款安排；摘要則指出，退款取決於航班載客率。

en.title: Southwest's Second-Seat Refund Depends on Flight Occupancy
en.summary: Southwest ties its second-seat refund to flight occupancy, leaving Customer of Size travelers facing uncertain costs.
body: Simple Flying reports that Southwest Airlines' new Customer of Size seating policy makes the second-seat refund depend on flight occupancy. The outlet's summary says this leaves plus-size travelers facing uncertain costs. Its headline says the flights typically run 80% full and characterizes the refund as a gamble.

The headline and summary link the occupancy condition with uncertainty over travelers' costs. In the account provided, flight occupancy is the stated factor affecting the refund, while the cost outcome for plus-size travelers is described as uncertain.

zh.title: Washington Dulles Airport將迎來VIP私人航廈
zh.summary: Washington Dulles Airport將迎來VIP航廈，商業旅客收費尚未確認。
body: Simple Flying報導，一座全新的VIP私人航廈將進駐Washington Dulles Airport。標題將該設施與$125 Million金額並列，並列出37,000平方英尺的面積，說明標題所述航廈的金額與規模。
Simple Flying摘要指出，商業旅客使用該設施的收費細節尚未確認。這項未確認資訊涉及商業旅客使用設施時的收費，摘要未提供已確認的收費金額。

en.title: VIP Private Terminal Coming to Washington Dulles Airport for $125 Million
en.summary: A VIP terminal is planned for Washington Dulles Airport; commercial passenger pricing remains unconfirmed.
body: Simple Flying reports that a brand-new VIP private terminal is coming to Washington Dulles Airport. Its headline associates the terminal with a $125 million figure and gives the facility's size as 37,000 square feet.

The publication's summary says pricing details for commercial passengers using the facility have not yet been confirmed. The pricing note concerns that passenger group; it does not provide a confirmed charge for their use of the terminal.
